title.value: Towards Detecting Contextual Real-Time Toxicity for In-Game Chat
title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on detecting toxicity in in-game chat, which is a real-time challenge faced by the gaming industry.
title.quote: We introduce ToxBuster, a simple and scalable model that reliably detects toxic content in real-time for a line of chat by including chat history and metadata.

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development of ToxBuster, a model aimed at detecting toxic language in real-time within in-game chat environments. The model leverages chat history and metadata to improve accuracy and has been tested across multiple games. ToxBuster outperforms existing solutions and can be adapted to other domains such as social media comment threads.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on toxicity detection in gaming environments, which does not directly align with any predefined eco-responsible AI categories.
primary_category.quote: Real-time toxicity detection in online environments poses a significant challenge, due to the increasing prevalence of social media and gaming platforms.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no sub-category in eco-responsible AI that fits the focus on real-time toxicity detection for gaming chat described in the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: We leverage recent advancements in large language models to create accurate and transferable models for effective content moderation.

new_primary_category.justification: The development of a model like ToxBuster to reduce toxicity in online games contributes to social well-being, particularly in fostering healthier online communities and protecting users from harassment and harmful behavior.
new_primary_category.quote: Real-time toxicity detection in online environments poses a significant challenge, due to the increasing prevalence of social media and gaming platforms.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper focuses on detecting and moderating toxic interactions within communication channels, specifically in the context of in-game chat.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We propose ToxBuster, the first real-time in-game chat toxicity detection model capable of integrating chat history and metadata.
